title: Steel pony truss bridge, Pratt web, 2 spans

provenance.basis: Illustrative archetype for visual explanation: proportions chosen for legibility at a common 24 m site; not a reconstruction of a specific bridge and not an engineering design. Parallel-chord pony truss (no top bracing below 4.5 m depth). Not structurally certified.

references.title: Truss bridge (Wikipedia)
references.excerpt: A Pratt truss includes vertical members and diagonals that slope down towards the center, the opposite of the Howe truss.
